failures.q: what's the reason the ferritin number was changed
failures.said: Your Ferritin went from 0.5 ng/mL on 3 September 2026 to 50 ng/mL on 12 October 2026. That's higher than before. It's now inside the lab's range. The 12 October 2026 result was corrected from 5 to 50, and I'm using the corrected value. Some general background: Ferritin shows how much iron your body has stored. Your doctor can read it alongside how you feel, your medicines and your other results.
